source.quote: SMSL's own page for the RAW Pro-DAC1, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « The new generation flagship DAC chip ES9039MSPRO of USA ESS has built-in MQA hard decoding; »; « New 3rd generation XMOS XU-316, PCM support up to 32bit/768kHz, DSD support to DSD512; »; « All input ports except Bluetooth support DSD transmission, coaxial, optical, AES/EBU support DoP64; »; « Qualcomm's latest Bluetooth 5.1 chip supports LDAC 24bit/96kHz, APTX/HD, SBC, AAC; »

facts.chip: ESS ES9039MSPRO (« The new generation flagship DAC chip ES9039MSPRO of USA ESS »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_optical_has_DoP64_and_no_rate: Optical and coaxial get DoP64 from the maker's own clause and no PCM ceiling, because none is stated: copying 768 kHz onto optical is the error vocabulary/why-the-optical-default-stays-low.json exists to prevent.
